name: G-REDscript Profiler 1.0.0
measurement_basis: Exact observed InvokeStatic/InvokeVirtual call-edge profiler derived from the proven Alpha measurement core

frame_time_companion.policy: CapFrameX is the tested recommendation, but another frame-time profiler or compatible CapFrameX version may be linked
frame_time_companion.source_ownership: copy-only; external files are never moved, deleted or modified

shutdown_behavior: if the game closes while recording, shutdown acts as implicit STOP and exports the capture accumulated so far
limitations: not every REDscript VM/intrinsic operation is observed
exclusive_instrumented_ms is instrumented-edge exclusive time rather than guaranteed full VM self time
wrapper boundaries can include uninstrumented/native/base work
virtual targets are not always concrete implementation ownership
profiler does not know mod dependency graphs and does not issue uninstall recommendations

manager_policy.existing_dll: never overwrite; exact packaged DLL is reported as already installed, any different GRSP DLL blocks installation
manager_policy.legacy_alpha_dll: detected and blocks installation so two profiler DLLs cannot load together
manager_policy.live_grsp_results: copy-verify-delete from the live game folder into package-local RESULTS
manager_policy.external_frame_time_results: copy-verify only; source files are never changed
manager_policy.restore: remove the managed DLL and managed data, archive any remaining live GRSP output first, then intentionally retain the final empty red4ext/plugins/G-REDscript-Profiler folder
